summary: Datadog did not answer, so the logs were not read. The database shows two leases past their expiry on the worker.

findings.title: Two leases stay held past their expiry

observations.observed: Two stage run leases expired 41 and 37 minutes ago and are still held by the same worker.

findings.hypothesis: The worker that holds the leases stopped renewing them without releasing them, which a stopped or hung worker process would do.
next_checks: Check whether the worker process that holds the leases is still running and when it last logged a line.
